title: How to dictate a prompt in ChatGPT on Mac: step by step with macOS Dictation
metaTitle: How to dictate a prompt in ChatGPT on Mac (2026 guide)
description: Learn how to dictate a prompt in ChatGPT on Mac with macOS Dictation: set it up, pick a start key, speak, check the text and send it.
targetKeyword: how to dictate a prompt in chatgpt on mac
intro: To dictate a prompt in ChatGPT on a Mac, turn on Dictation in System Settings, click into the prompt box, then press your start key and speak. Press Esc to stop, check the text, then press Return to send it.
tldr: Turn on Dictation in System Settings > Keyboard > Dictation, then choose a start key such as Press Fn Twice.
Click into the ChatGPT prompt box, press your start key, speak, then press Esc to stop.
Read the text before you press Return, because reports describe dictated text disappearing.
ChatGPT's Voice experience was retired in the Mac app on January 15, 2026. Dictation is a separate feature.

task: Dictate a prompt in ChatGPT on Mac
requirements: A Mac on a current macOS release with Dictation available
A ChatGPT account, in the Mac app or at chatgpt.com
A working microphone shown under System Settings > Sound > Input
Dictation turned on in System Settings > Keyboard > Dictation

steps.name: Turn on Dictation
steps.text: Click the Apple menu, then System Settings. Click Keyboard in the sidebar, then open Dictation. Turn Dictation on. If macOS asks, click Enable, then choose whether to share audio recordings with Apple.
steps.tip: Make the audio sharing choice on purpose. The privacy section of this guide explains what it covers.

steps.name: Set your start key
steps.text: In the Shortcut pop-up, choose Press Fn (Function) Key Twice, keep the Microphone key, or pick a custom shortcut such as Option-Z.
steps.tip: If the Fn key does something else on your Mac, pick a custom shortcut instead.

steps.name: Allow microphone access
steps.text: Open Privacy & Security, then Microphone. Turn on the switch for ChatGPT, and for any other app you dictate into. If ChatGPT is not in the list, start dictation once in the app and check again.
steps.tip: Confirm your input device under Sound > Input so you know the Mac hears you.

steps.name: Open ChatGPT and click the prompt box
steps.text: Open the ChatGPT Mac app, or go to chatgpt.com in Safari or Chrome. Click inside the prompt box until a blinking cursor shows. Dictated words land at the cursor, so the cursor must be in the box first.
steps.tip: If the cursor is not in the box, your words may land in another field.

steps.name: Start dictating
steps.text: Press Fn twice, or the shortcut you chose. Speak in short phrases at a normal pace. Say comma or period when you want punctuation, and say new line to start a new line.
steps.tip: Pause briefly between sentences. Long silences end the session.

steps.name: Stop and check the text
steps.text: Press Esc, the Microphone key, or your start shortcut to stop. Read the text in the box. Fix names, numbers and symbols by hand before you send.
steps.tip: Dictation also stops on its own after 30 seconds without detected speech.

steps.name: Send the prompt
steps.text: Press Return to send. If Return adds a new line in your build, click the send button instead. Read the reply and check it against what you said.
steps.tip: For long prompts, copy the text to a note before you send, in case it disappears.

troubleshooting.fix: Check Privacy & Security > Microphone for the app you use, and confirm your input under Sound > Input. Dictate once into Notes. If Notes works and ChatGPT does not, copy your draft and try chatgpt.com in a browser.

troubleshooting.problem: The mic icon gets stuck or resets
troubleshooting.fix: Press Esc, click back into the prompt box and start again. Copy anything you already dictated first. Reports about ChatGPT's Dictate button describe this, and no fix was recorded in the thread through November 2025.

Dictate in shorter bursts and copy the text often. Reports describe dictations over 30 seconds vanishing, and one user lost a 15-minute dictation. OpenAI's help center is where it pointed users in that thread.

troubleshooting.problem: Dictation does nothing while Voice Control is on
troubleshooting.fix: Apple says standard Dictation is not available while Voice Control is on. Turn Voice Control off in System Settings, then try your start key again.

troubleshooting.problem: Dictation stops in the middle of a sentence
troubleshooting.fix: macOS stops dictation after 30 seconds without detected speech. Press your start key and carry on, and keep talking through short pauses.

troubleshooting.problem: Text lands in the wrong place
troubleshooting.fix: Dictation types at the cursor. Click into the prompt box, confirm a blinking cursor, then start again.

faq.question: Does the ChatGPT Mac app have a Dictate button?
faq.answer: We could not confirm it. Some third-party guides say the Mac app shows a Dictate button, and others do not. Look for a microphone icon in the prompt box. If it is not there, use macOS Dictation with your start key.

faq.question: Why does pressing Fn twice do nothing?
faq.answer: Check that Dictation is on in System Settings > Keyboard > Dictation, and that the shortcut is set to Press Fn (Function) Key Twice. Apple says standard Dictation is not available while Voice Control is on. Also confirm the cursor is in a text field.

faq.question: Is ChatGPT Voice still available in the Mac app?
faq.answer: No. OpenAI retired the Voice experience in the ChatGPT macOS app on January 15, 2026, according to release notes quoted by 9to5Mac. Voice continues on chatgpt.com, iOS, Android and the Windows app.

faq.question: How long can I dictate in one go?
faq.answer: Apple's guide stops dictation automatically after 30 seconds without detected speech. The sources we checked do not list a maximum length for one session. Keep prompts in short bursts and copy them often.

faq.question: Will my dictated words go to Apple?
faq.answer: During setup, Apple's guide asks whether you want to share audio recordings with Apple. Choose the option you are comfortable with. On macOS 27, English spelling, punctuation and capitalization can run on-device on M3 or later Macs with at least 12GB of unified memory.

faq.question: Does dictation work in ChatGPT inside a browser?
faq.answer: macOS Dictation types into any text field that has a cursor, so the same steps should work at chatgpt.com in Safari or Chrome. Reports about ChatGPT's own Dictate button also named Safari and Chrome, so test it once before you rely on it.

faq.question: Why did my dictated text disappear?
faq.answer: A developer forum thread describes dictated speech vanishing from ChatGPT's Dictate button, especially in dictations over 30 seconds. Users reported it from April 2025 onward, and no fix was recorded in the thread through November 2025. Copy long text before you send it.

faq.question: Can I dictate in a language other than English?
faq.answer: The sources we checked do not confirm which languages every dictation setup supports. Apple's on-device punctuation model is English on macOS 27. Check the language in the Dictation pane, then test one sentence in that language before a long prompt.

blocks.text: Dictation is often the quickest way to get a long prompt into ChatGPT on a Mac, once it is set up. macOS Dictation does the work, so ChatGPT only needs a cursor in the prompt box. This guide covers setup, the start and stop keys, how to check the text, and the problems people hit most often.

We could not confirm the exact dictation controls inside the ChatGPT Mac app. OpenAI's help pages did not load when we checked. So the steps below use macOS Dictation, which types into any text field, and they tell you what to look for in ChatGPT.
What you need before you start

You need a Mac, a ChatGPT account and a microphone that works. A built-in microphone is enough, and so is a headset you have already tested. Check the input under System Settings > Sound > Input before you start, so you know the Mac hears you.

items: A Mac on a current macOS release with Dictation available. Apple's guide in our sources covers macOS 27.
A ChatGPT account, signed in to the Mac app or to chatgpt.com.
A microphone that appears under System Settings > Sound > Input.
A short test in Notes, so you know dictation works before you rely on it in ChatGPT.

blocks.text: Turn on macOS Dictation first

Dictation is set up in System Settings, not inside ChatGPT. Click the Apple menu, choose System Settings, then click Keyboard in the sidebar. Scroll to Dictation and turn it on. If macOS asks, click Enable.
Apple's guide then asks whether you want to share audio recordings with Apple. Make that choice on purpose. The privacy section below explains what it covers.

blocks.title: Menu names can change
blocks.text: Apple's guide covers macOS 27. On older releases the Dictation pane can look different, so search System Settings for Dictation if a step does not match.
Pick a start key that works for you

Apple's guide gives three ways to start dictation. You can press and release the Microphone key. You can press Fn twice, using the Press Fn (Function) Key Twice option. You can also choose a custom shortcut, such as Option-Z, from the Shortcut pop-up.

rows: Press and release the Microphone key
Press Fn, then press Fn again quickly
Press the combination you chose, such as Option-Z
blocks.caption: Start options listed in Apple's Dictation guide.

blocks.text: Pick a key you can hit without thinking. Fn sits in the bottom-left corner on most Mac keyboards. A custom shortcut avoids clashes with other apps, but make sure it does not clash with one you already use.
Stop keys matter too. Esc stops dictation, and so does the Microphone key or the shortcut you started with. Practice starting and stopping in Notes before you try it in ChatGPT.
Find the microphone in the ChatGPT prompt box
Open ChatGPT, either the Mac app or chatgpt.com in Safari or Chrome. Click the prompt box until a blinking cursor shows. Then look at the right side of the box for a microphone icon.

Some third-party guides say the Mac app has a Dictate button, and others disagree, so we do not rely on either one. If the icon is there, you can use it. If it is not, your start key still works in the same box. Dictation types into whichever field has focus, so check the cursor first.
Speak, stop and check the text

Speak in short phrases at a normal pace. Words appear at the cursor as you talk, with capital letters added where Apple's dictation expects them. Say 'comma', 'period' or 'question mark' when you want punctuation. Say 'new line' to start a new line.

Stop with Esc, the Microphone key or your start shortcut. Dictation also stops by itself after 30 seconds without detected speech. Short pauses are fine, but a long silence ends the session. Press your key and carry on.
Long prompts and lost text

The biggest risk is losing words. A developer forum thread posted on April 23, 2025 describes ChatGPT's Dictate button losing dictated speech with no save or retry option. Users reported that dictations longer than 30 seconds disappeared, and the mic icon sometimes got stuck.

One user said a 15-minute dictation was lost on May 13, 2025. By November 2025, users in the same thread said the bug was still open. That thread covers ChatGPT's own button on iOS, the web and macOS browsers. No app version numbers were recorded, so test on your build.

blocks.title: Save before you send
blocks.text: Copy long dictations to a note before you press Return. Reports describe text vanishing with no way to get it back.
ChatGPT Voice on Mac is retired, but dictation is separate

Dictation and Voice are different features. Dictation turns your speech into text in the box. Voice is a spoken conversation where ChatGPT talks back. OpenAI retired the Voice experience in the ChatGPT macOS app on January 15, 2026.

According to release notes quoted by 9to5Mac, Voice continues on chatgpt.com, iOS, Android and the Windows app. The 9to5Mac article does not say whether dictation was affected, so test it on your build. If you want spoken back and forth on a Mac, use chatgpt.com in your browser.
A worked example: dictating a messy request
Say you want ChatGPT to draft a reply to a landlord. You speak the request and the punctuation words with it. The table shows what lands in the box for three common phrases.

headers: What appears in the prompt box
rows: Can you draft a reply to my landlord question mark
Can you draft a reply to my landlord?
Keep it polite comma but firm period
Ask for a repair by Friday period
Ask for a repair by Friday.
blocks.caption: Spoken punctuation in Apple's dictation. Check each result before you send.

blocks.text: Read the result out loud once. Dictation often gets names, numbers and dates slightly wrong. Fix those by hand before you press Return.
Mistakes people make when dictating prompts

items: Starting to speak before the cursor is in the prompt box.
Dictating names, account numbers or dates, then sending without reading them back.
Dictating code. Brackets, slashes and quote marks are easy to get wrong, so type them.
Expecting dictation to fix a vague request. A fuzzy idea spoken aloud is still a fuzzy prompt.
Talking over a fan or a TV. Background sound produces more mistakes.
Pausing long enough to end the session, then continuing as if it were still running.
Looking for Voice mode in the Mac app after the January 2026 retirement.

blocks.text: How much faster is speaking than typing?

Speech can be much faster than typing for prose. A 2016 lab study on an iPhone 6 Plus found English speech entry was about 2.93 times faster than keyboard entry. The numbers were 153 words per minute against 52. That was a phone, so treat it as a rough guide for a Mac.

Accuracy was mixed. Speech had a lower corrected error rate during entry, 5.30% against 11.22%. But the final text had slightly more uncorrected errors, 1.30% against 0.79%. Speech is quick, and checking still matters.
What Apple receives when you dictate

Apple's guide says you can choose whether to share audio recordings with Apple during setup. On macOS 27, dictation uses an on-device model for spelling, punctuation and capitalization in English. That model needs a Mac with an M3 chip or later and at least 12GB of unified memory.

If your Mac or language does not match those details, read what the Dictation pane says on your machine. ChatGPT still receives the text you send, the same as any prompt. Dictation changes how the words get into the box, not what happens after you press Return.
Next steps after dictation works

Once dictation is reliable, the next question is usually the window and the shortcut. [How to use the Option+Space shortcut in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/use-the-option-space-shortcut-in-chatgpt) covers that shortcut step by step.

Dictation helps most when you can speak faster than you type. [Check your typing speed](/tools/typing-speed-test) and [compare speaking with typing](/tools/speaking-vs-typing-test) to see where you stand. If you want to know whether ChatGPT can see your window, read [ChatGPT voice on Mac and the screen](/blog/chatgpt-voice-mac-screen).
When typing still wins

Dictation is a poor fit for URLs, code, passwords and single commands. Typing is faster for those, and it avoids errors you would have to hunt down later. Use dictation for long, loose prompts, and type the precise parts.
Many people switch between the two inside one prompt. They speak the background, then type the link or the exact figure. That mix keeps the prompt fast and the details correct.
